methodology.early: First latched SELL decision strictly before actual entry source index+9; only actual B/R equal-entry and both-CLOSED pairs have fixed-H10 incremental labels.
methodology.P: Known at first support-break decision close: normalized HFQ close/(actual buy fill price*1.001)-1>0. Buy fee included; no future sell fee deducted. Zero threshold fixed, not searched.
methodology.parent: Known decision day Open<prior Close and Close>Open; original low-open recovery form, no additional threshold.
methodology.floor_falling: Current previous5 minimum less than previous-day previous5 minimum; known at close.
methodology.entry_below_previous_broken_floor: Current entry signal close below support floor stored at immediately previous actual cycle early-break decision. Null if previous cycle had no early break. Diagnostic actual-path label, not a simulated new entry policy.
methodology.returns: R-B position-return difference for same entry excludes capital path differences; actual residual-cash cyclelog difference shown separately. Entry-year cohorts are not calendar-year NAV.
methodology.cutoff: WITHOUT2026 uses actual 2025-12-31 mark; early-exit mean excludes either-leg OPEN/right-censored/unmatched cases. Such episodes retained separately.

limits: Existing account path diagnostic only; selecting a subset cannot reproduce a conditional exit account.
All outcomes are seen research labels, whereas split conditions are known at decision close.
Only fixed previously motivated price states evaluated; no threshold search and no new acceptance gate.
